serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText: #bot.Expression.happy Bot: Hello everyone! Lady Annalie: Hello! You look amazing! You: How long were you two waiting for us? Lady Annalie: I just came a few minutes before you. Melissa was already here. Melissa: I have time to spare. #Annalie_Outside.face.pervy Lady Annalie: Oh~ She felt bad about being late the last time, so she came earlier~ So cute! #Annalie_Outside.face.normal #Cashier.Eyes.closed #Cashier.Mouth.open Melissa: Eh… #Cashier.Mouth.normal Melissa: Nonsense. I came earlier because I had nothing better to do. #Annalie_Outside.face.pervy Lady Annalie: Oi! Anon! Maybe she doesn’t hate you and is just a tsundere! That would be a major revelation! #Cashier.Eyes.normal You: Somehow I doubt that’s the case… Call it a gut feeling. Lady Annalie: You sure? Let’s ask her! Lady Annalie: Melissa, are you secretly a tsundere? Melissa: … Melissa: Who knows. Lady Annalie: Ah! She didn’t say no! Yes! That pretty much confirms that she is one! #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Suprised+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Hmm Melissa: I don’t even know what ‘tsundere’ is. Lady Annalie: Are you, like, serious with me right now, girl? Melissa: I don’t watch these Chinese cartoons like the rest of you. #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Normal+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Pervy Lady Annalie: You are missing out. How about I send you some recommendations, huh? Melissa: I’m super busy, so I will pass. #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Closed+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Pervy Lady Annalie: What a shame! #Annalie_Outside.face.normal Bot: You can send these recommendations to me if you want. I didn’t watch that many of them either. Lady Annalie: Come on now. Don’t make me into a weeb! I can’t believe no one here watches anime in this day and age. It’s totally mainstream now! Lady Annalie: Anon! I’m sure you watched a lot back in the day, right? #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Sad+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Pervy Lady Annalie: Especially the harem ones~ That would explain your ambitions of befriending every girl around~ You: It’s completely normal for a healthy young boy to watch these, stop teasing me! #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Suprised+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Open #bot.Expression.clear #bot.Expression.sad Lady Annalie: Oh, wow~ I didn’t think you would admit it so easily, especially in public. You really are shrewd~ Bot: Is it something shameful to watch these things? #Annalie_Outside.face.pervy Lady Annalie: You will have to judge it for yourself, {f_botName}! Go watch some together later~ Lady Annalie: If you are short on time, just skip right to the hot spring episode. It doesn’t matter what series it is, if it’s a harem there must be one. #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Suprised+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Hmm You: You are quite an expert yourself, it seems and yet I’m the only one being called shrewd. Doesn’t seem fair. #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Sad+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Pervy Lady Annalie: Being pervy as a girl is an asset! No one likes boring women! But being pervy as a guy…{{wi}} Is just creepy! Melissa: I agree with your observation. You: E-Even Melissa… You: I don’t watch that kind of stuff anymore, right, {f_botName}? #bot.Expression.clear #bot.Expression.happy #Annalie_Outside.face.normal Bot: You are right! I have never witnessed something like this! Lady Annalie: Oh~ you had to ask your girl for help~ How pathetic~ You: Give me a break… {{wi}}We came here to bowl, so how about we start? Bot: I’m ready! You: Annalie, where are your bowling shoes? #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Sad+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Awww Lady Annalie: You want me to wear those stinky, foot-fungus-infested flip-flops? No way in hell I’m gonna wear those! You: Don’t be a child, people running this place could kick you out, you know? Lady Annalie: I will take my chances. If push comes to shove, I will just pay them to fuck off! You: Are you going to be fine in those? It would suck if you broke your ankle on your first throw. #bot.Expression.VeryShock #Cashier.Eyes.closed+Cashier.Mouth.open Lady Annalie: Better watch your mouth! The last person who underestimated me cummed to death! #Cashier.Face.normal #bot.Expression.clear #bot.Expression.sad You: Y-Yeah, somehow I don’t believe you… #Annalie_Outside.face.pervy Lady Annalie: Oh really? Do you want to find out? Bot: Please don’t do it. He’s too young to die… #bot.Expression.clear You: She’s just joking, {f_botName}... #Annalie_Outside.face.normal You: Alright, Annalie, if you don’t want to change your shoes, you can be the first to throw. Lady Annalie: Sure, no problem. You: Did you even bowl before? #Cashier.Eyes.closed+Cashier.Mouth.open Lady Annalie: With an actual bowling ball? Never, but I was pretty good on the console version. You: … #Cashier.Face.normal Melissa: How about I throw the first ball? Annalie would at least have a chance to see how to do it properly. #bot.Expression.happy Bot: If that’s the case I can also be the first to do it. Great. We didn’t even start and {f_botName} already is competing with Melissa. Melissa: Suit yourself, {f_botName}. You can throw first. Lady Annalie: Come on guys, it can’t be that hard. It’s just throwing a ball! I’m going to be fine, jeez. After saying that Annalie reached for one of the bowling balls. #Annalie_Outside.face.suprised Lady Annalie: W-Woa... Is it supposed to be that heavy? #Annalie_Outside.Eyes.Sad+Annalie_Outside.Mouth.Awww Lady Annalie: Oi. You all. I can hear how you are silently judging me. I was just a little surprised, that’s all. You: No one is saying a thing. Please continue. Bot: You can do it, Annalie! #Annalie_Outside.face.sad Melissa: Anon. Does our agreement include visiting her in the hospital? You: N-No, I don’t think so. Lady Annalie: Stop chattering! I can’t concentrate! … #Annalie_Outside.face.normal Lady Annalie: Here I go!
